classification.difficultyReason: 1E Q14: Linked familiar operations with signs, exact values or endpoint/domain checks. Positive division by 3 retains both signs; lower endpoint is included and upper endpoint excluded.

content.prompt: Solve the inequality and represent the solution on a number line. $$1\le3x-5<10.$$

answer.worked:
Add $5$ to all three expressions, then divide by $3$.

$$\begin{align*}6&\le3x<15\\2&\le x<5\end{align*}$$
